teaser: Five in the morning, and the plan for the day is already arranged before the coffee finishes dripping. That ordering hand belongs to life path 1, the leader; the quiet behind it belongs to INFP, a temperament built on private conviction more than public drive. Most who carry the 1 push outward first and work out what they believe later. You tend to run it the other way: the conviction comes first, worked out alone, and only then does the will to lead catch up to it. The crossing here is a pioneer who needs to feel sure before stepping out, not after.
excerpt: The last word in an argument gets written down before it is said out loud, tested first on paper.
